steps.title: Prepare the egg mixture
steps.content: In large mixing bowl combine 30 egg yolk with 400g sugar. Whisk or beat until the mixture becomes pale, thick, and creamy. Set aside in chiller

steps.title: Prepare the coffee
steps.content: Mix 2.4 L hot water with 100g sugar and 60g coffee powder. Stir well till slightly boil

steps.title: Prepare the cream mixture
steps.content: In a separate bowl, whip 1kg cream cheese till smooth. Add gradually 2 L whip cream until soft peaks form and fully combined. Fold in the egg-sugar mixture carefully to keep it light and airy — this is your tiramisu cream

steps.title: Assemble the tiramisu
steps.content: Quickly dip ladyfinger biscuits into the hot/warm coffee syrup, do not soak them too long to avoid sogginess. Arrange a layer of soaked biscuits in your tray or dish. Spread a layer of tiramisu cream evenly on top. Repeat the process (biscuits-cream) until the dish is full, finishing with cream layer on top

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.content: Cover the tiramisu and refrigerate for at least 4-5 hours (overnight is best) to let the flavours meld. Before serving, dust generously with cocoa powder
